changes: Rewrote `/agent/solver.md` as a phased workflow. The main failure in the report was submitting untested code: many failures were submitted after 2–3 calls with no public-example run, or after a failing example, and some were never timed on max-size input. The new prompt requires passing every public example via run_tests before submitting, a brute-force comparison on small random inputs, and a timing check on max-size input. It also says a sample mismatch is not automatically acceptable, because the hidden grader seems to compare output exactly. The trial on lcb-abc366-g showed the agent testing properly but dismissing sample mismatches as "any valid answer", which is why that last rule was added. I did not run a trial after that final edit.
final:
The solver prompt is updated and passes validation. I used one of my three trials, and it still failed, so the gain is unproven.
